        { q: "What are coins?", a: "Coins are a virtual currency inside CIRCA. They have no cash value, and they are used to send connection requests (text or voice) and for Priority Match." },
        { q: "How do I get coins?", a: "Coins are bought through Apple In-App Purchase in the coin store. Prices you see in the store come from the App Store for your region." },
        { q: "What can coins be used for?", a: "Sending a connection request costs 10 coins, whether it is a text or voice introduction. Priority Match costs 20 coins for 15 minutes." },
        { q: "Can coins be transferred?", a: "No. Coins stay on your account and cannot be sent to another student, withdrawn, or exchanged for money." },
        { q: "Can coins be refunded?", a: "If a premium action fails, the coins are returned automatically and shown in your history. App Store payment refunds are handled by Apple." },
        { q: "What happens if a purchase fails?", a: "No coins are added and your balance is unchanged. You can try again from the coin store or contact support." },
        { q: "How do I contact support?", a: "Use purchase support below. Include the transaction identifier from your history so we can find it quickly." }
